verdict.rationale: The only relevant control is a developer statement that Conductor now supports fine-grained GitHub repository access, or skipping the integration in favor of local GitHub CLI auth. Per-organization agent connection settings (API key vs. subscription) are a narrower admin control. Nothing shows a lead can allowlist or deny the tools, MCP servers or integrations an agent may use, and cloud docs say agents run builds without confirming each step. Missing for 10: per-agent tool/integration allowlists or denylists, MCP/tool permission policies, org-level admin enforcement, first-party documentation of integration access controls.
